grid-line.$description: Grid Line — Primary border between tiles and around media surfaces — the only structural divider in the system, doing the work of card outlines, section separators, and elevation simultaneously

body-text.$description: Body Text — Primary readable text — project names, bio copy, metadata labels

muted-text.$description: Muted Text — Secondary metadata, category tags, and the [link] indicator — recedes behind body text to create a two-tier reading hierarchy without changing weight

subtle-divider.$description: Subtle Divider — Low-contrast internal dividers and edge treatments — barely visible against the page background, used where a hairline would be too loud

commit-mono.$description: Used for every text element in the system — headings, body, metadata, links, tags. The entire UI is a single monospace family; there is no sans-serif counterpart.
